decisions.WIM-015: Measure deterministic research completion and approved research WU/day. Prefer a live projected estimate; use V27 effective 45 WU/day only when a live projection is unavailable. Treat 99 WU/day as a legacy theoretical value and audit duplicate multipliers before accepting any result near it.
decisions.WIM-016: Implement light, temperature, water, and soil satisfied-time as real crop growth gates.
decisions.WIM-020: Use physical kg as the single mass authority for equipment, hauling, and storage; do not author a second equipped-mass value.
decisions.WIM-022: Emergency suturing reduces the actual ongoing bleeding rate.
decisions.WIM-023: Transplant, prosthetic, and reinforcement procedures persist real body-part installation, replacement, or reinforcement state.
decisions.WIM-031: Keep central-account payment authority. Remove per-payment physical coin hauling claims; describe vaults as capacity, theft, and protection infrastructure.
decisions.WIM-036: Implement substance-specific fatigue, research/vision, and pain effects instead of relying only on generic mood/work/combat multipliers.
decisions.WIM-038: Update the wiki to the live daily candidate evaluation, definition/category cooldown, resident occupancy, and normal/emergency slot rules.
decisions.WIM-045: Implement physical door open/closed state for movement blocking and environment propagation; access policy controls who may open it.
decisions.WIM-049: Reclassify as outbound expedition combat. Enemy generation follows authored encounters plus campaign calibration; requiredPower is a recommended party-power readout validated by win-rate regressions, not an input that rescales the same enemy again.
decisions.WIM-054: Remove mutable captive health as an independent authority. Project a read-only 0-100 summary from common body health and apply labor gates, interaction harm, and medical priority to the real body state.
decisions.WIM-061: The signal horn is invasion-rally only. Remove its claimed fire effect; fire response remains an independent AI responsibility.
